review_notes: The file contains only data: Array NodeClaim definitions (branchClaims5And10Group00 and similar) and BranchClaims wrappers for the rows 5/10, 5/11, 5/12, 5/14 and 5/15. It defines no new structures, classes or concepts. NodeClaim and BranchClaims are declared in CoverageCertificateChecker.lean, outside this file. The literals are encoded certificate data for a specific Erdős 97 octagon coverage check, not a reimplementation of any Mathlib notion. Nothing in the file competes with an existing Mathlib, Batteries or core concept, so I found no justified finding under this rubric. I did not examine the checker's structure definitions for internal duplication, as that is outside the target file.
